name: vortex-hold-to-confirm
intent: Hold a central core 900ms to build three rotating rings; early release cancels — never confirms before threshold.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Manual holds still require holdMs 900 but skip rotating rings; Run/Replay resolve immediately to CONFIRMED

acceptance: Early release before holdMs 900 never confirms — status CANCELLED and rings retreat in cancelMs 200
Full hold of holdMs 900 builds ringCount 3 then CONFIRMED with confirmPulseMs 180
Replay resets to IDLE before another hold cycle
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) keeps the 900ms threshold on manual hold; Run/Replay resolve immediately
